Four high school girls turn their lazy days into a melodious adventure within the cozy walls of their school's light music club. Between brewing fragrant tea and baking sweet cakes, the tight-knit group strums their instruments to create a heartwarming soundtrack of youth. This soothing slice-of-life anime captures the gentle beauty of ordinary moments and the quiet magic of lifelong friendship in Kyoto.
